title: Online Budget Allocation with Censored Semi-Bandit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2508.05844v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study a stochastic budget-allocation problem over $K$ tasks. At each round $t$, the learner chooses an allocation $X_t \in \Delta_K$. Task $k$ succeeds with probability $F_k(X_{t,k})$, where $F_1,\dots,F_K$ are nondecreasing budget-to-success curves, and upon success yields a random reward with unknown mean $\mu_k$. The learner observes which tasks succeed, and observes a task's reward only upon success (censored semi-bandit feedback). This model captures, for instance, splitting payments across crowdsourcing workers or distributing bids across simultaneous auctions, and subsumes stochastic multi-armed bandits and semi-bandits. We design an optimism-based algorithm that operates under censored semi-bandit feedback and assumes access to an exact maximization oracle. Our main result is an instance-dependent bound showing that in diminishing-returns regimes, the regret of this algorithm scales polylogarithmically with the horiz

translated_title: 基于删失半老虎机反馈的在线预算分配
translated_abstract: 我们研究了跨 K 个任务的随机预算分配问题。在每一轮 t，学习者选择一个分配方案 X_t ∈ Δ_K。任务 k 以概率 F_k(X_{t,k}) 成功，其中 F_1,...,F_K 是非递减的预算-成功曲线，任务成功时会产生一个均值为未知数 μ_k 的随机奖励。学习者可以观察到哪些任务成功了，且只有当任务成功时才能观察到该任务的奖励（删失半老虎机反馈）。该模型可以刻画诸如将支付分配给众包工作者或将出价分配给同时进行的多个拍卖等场景，并且涵盖了随机多臂老虎机和半老虎机问题。我们设计了一种基于乐观原则的算法，该算法能够在删失半老虎机反馈下运行，并假设可以使用一个精确的最大化 oracle。我们的主要结果是一个依赖于实例的界，表明在收益递减的情形下，该算法的遗憾随时间范围呈多对数级增长。
tldr: 本文研究了删失半老虎机反馈下的在线预算分配问题，提出了一种基于乐观原则的算法，并证明在收益递减情形下其遗憾随时间范围呈多对数级增长。
en_tdlr: This paper studies online budget allocation under censored semi-bandit feedback, proposes an optimism-based algorithm, and proves that its regret scales polylogarithmically with the horizon in diminishing-returns regimes.
